{{dablink|This page refers to the nut eaten by the Aiel. For disambiguation, see [[pecara (disambiguation)]]. For the tree, see [[pecara (tree)]]. For the boar-like animal, see [[pecara (animal)]].}}
[[File:19902F8D-98B8-4883-89F4-845DC44DB73D.jpeg|thumb|220x220px]]
'''''Pecara''''' are pale, wrinkled nuts found in the [[Aiel Waste]], possibly like a walnut or pecan.{{Ref/book|5|2}}

[[Aviendha]] mentioned roasting ''pecara'' when dissuading [[Elayne]] from going to [[Rand al'Thor]] during the [[cleansing of saidin]].{{ref/book|10|10}} Since [[pecara (animal)|the boar-like animal]] is never mentioned by name in the main series or the {{twotc}}, she was probably referring to the nuts.
{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Pecara'' (nut)}}
